name: Ratnagiri – Brown Sugar Reserve - Value | Auto Discounted | No Codes
description:
Ratnagiri Estate Terroir Fermentation – Brown Sugar Reserve.  
  🌱  Process:  Anaerobic Natural with Native Terroir Microbes  
 This is a beautifully balanced microlot from  Ratnagiri Estate , showcasing how terroir-driven fermentation can produce deep sweetness and layered fruit complexity while maintaining clarity in the cup. 
 ☕  Roast Profile Available:  Light Plus 
  100% Arabica  
 Sourced from a  single lot at Ratnagiri Estate , this coffee is crafted from carefully harvested ripe cherries with a  Brix level of 23.8 , indicating excellent fruit maturity and sugar development. 
 The cherries come from  Block 5/1 of the 17 Acres Patte section , planted with the  Catuai varietal , known for its clean structure and ability to express terroir-driven sweetness. 
 After harvest, only the ripest cherries are selected and the floaters are removed. The cherries are then transferred into  bio-fermenters where they undergo a controlled 48-hour anaerobic fermentation using native terroir microbes naturally present on the fruit . This process allows the estate’s unique microbial environment to shape the flavor development of the coffee. 
 Following fermentation, the cherries are dried slowly on  raised beds for approximately 29 days , completing the process as a  natural coffee . The slow drying stabilizes the sugars and enhances the development of caramel-like sweetness and fruit complexity. 
 The beans are then roasted  Light Plus , preserving the coffee’s natural sweetness and aromatic structure. 
 The cup opens with a  rich brown sugar sweetness , smooth and caramel-like, forming the foundation of the profile. This is followed by subtle layers of  mulberry, grapes, and guava , adding gentle fruit complexity. As the coffee cools, softer notes of  banana and delicate black tea  appear, bringing a refined, elegant finish with a lingering sweetness. 
 This is a terroir-focused coffee that highlights how  native microbial fermentation and slow natural drying can produce a clean yet deeply sweet cup.  
 📍  Estate:  Ratnagiri Estate 📍  Block:  RG 5/1 – 17 Acres Patte 🌿  Varietal:  Catuai 🌱  Process:  Anaerobic Natural with Native Terroir Microbes 🕒  Fermentation:  48 hours in bio-fermenters 🌞  Drying:  29 days on raised beds 🔥  Roast:  Light Plus 
 Tasting Notes 
 🍯 Brown Sugar 🍇 Mulberry / Grapes / Guava 🍌 Banana 🍵 Tea 
 Flavor Intensity Guide 
 Brown Sugar – 3.5 / 4 Banana – 3 / 4 Tea – 3 / 4 Mulberry / Grapes / Guava – 2 / 4 
 Experience  Ratnagiri Brown Sugar Reserve —a terroir-driven microlot where natural fermentation and slow drying create a cup defined by caramel sweetness, gentle fruit complexity, and elegant tea-like finish.

 This is one of the most technically experimental microlots we have produced this year—an expressive coffee that demonstrates how extreme temperature contrast and controlled fermentation can unlock deep fruit complexity and wine-like character. 
 ☕  Roast Profile Available:  Light Plus 
  100% Arabica  
 Rooted in our own estate at  Kalyancool , this microlot explores the effect of  thermal shock processing combined with controlled yeast fermentation . Carefully selected fully ripened red cherries are first sorted to remove floaters and underripe fruits, ensuring only dense, high-quality cherries enter the process. 
 The cherries are then subjected to a  thermal shock treatment , where they are immersed in  55°C warm water for 5 minutes . This controlled heat exposure helps soften the fruit structure and prepares the cherries for rapid cellular stress. Immediately after heating, the cherries are transferred to  ice chamber and rapidly chilled , remaining in the cold bath for around  7–8 minutes . 
 This dramatic temperature contrast creates a “thermal shock” effect that enhances permeability of the fruit and intensifies the interaction between sugars, microbes, and yeast during fermentation. 
 After the thermal treatment, the cherries are gently  bruised to create a bruised natural process , allowing partial opening of the fruit skin while maintaining the natural mucilage and pulp around the beans. 
 The cherries are then inoculated with  activated Lalcafe Intenso yeast , a strain chosen for its ability to enhance fruity aromatics and wine-like complexity. Fermentation takes place in  sealed Eco-tact bags for 72 hours , allowing controlled anaerobic conditions to develop layered fruit character. 
 Once fermentation is complete, the coffee is dried as naturals and carefully  light (light plus) roasted  to preserve clarity, acidity, and aromatic intensity. 
 The cup opens with  fresh watermelon sweetness , juicy and refreshing. This is followed by vibrant  pomegranate acidity , adding brightness and structure. As the coffee develops on the palate, deeper  grape-wine notes emerge , bringing a rich fermented fruit character. As the cup cools, darker fruit layers of  prunes and dried grapes  appear, creating a long, wine-like finish with lingering sweetness. 
 This is a bold experimental coffee designed to showcase how  thermal shock processing and precision fermentation can transform natural coffees into intensely fruit-driven microlots.  
 📍  Estate:  Kalyancool Estate, Chikmagalur 🌿  Process:  Thermal Shock Bruised Natural 🌡  Thermal Shock Step:  55°C warm water → immediate ice bath 🕒  Fermentation:  72 hours anaerobic fermentation 🌱  Yeast:  Lalcafe Intenso 🔥  Roast:  Light 
  Varietal:  Chandragiri, Selection 795 
 Tasting Notes 
 🍉 Watermelon 🍷 Grape Wine 🍎 Pomegranate 🍇 Dried Grapes 🍑 Prunes 
   
 Experience  Thermal Shock - Ruby Pulse  —a striking experimental microlot where extreme temperature contrast, bruised natural processing, and controlled fermentation combine to produce a vibrant, wine-like cup. 
  Resting Period:  Minimum 10 days.

name: Udayagiri Alpine Selection

name: Udaygiri Whisky Barrel Aged Coffee
description:
Udaygiri Estate Whisky Barrel Aged – Oak Reserve  
 This is one of the most refined barrel-aged coffees we have roasted this year—an elegant microlot where specialty coffee meets the depth and character of whisky oak maturation. 
 ☕  Roast Profile Available:  Light Plus 
  100% Arabica  
 Sourced from  Udaygiri Estate in Chikmagalur , this microlot explores how oak maturation can enhance coffee complexity while preserving clarity and fruit structure. 
 Carefully selected ripe cherries are processed as naturals and dried to the ideal moisture level. Once stabilized, the green beans are transferred into  seasoned whisky barrels  that previously held aged whisky. The beans are then  rested inside the barrels for several weeks , allowing the porous green coffee to slowly absorb the aromatic compounds embedded in the oak. 
 During this maturation period, the beans take on subtle layers of  oak wood tannins, vanilla sweetness, and whisky-like aromatic complexity , while still preserving the natural fruit character of the coffee. 
 Once the desired infusion is achieved, the beans are removed and roasted  Light Plus , ensuring the barrel characteristics remain elegant and integrated rather than overpowering. 
 The cup opens with crisp  green apple acidity , bright and refreshing. This is followed by juicy layers of  kiwi, grapes, and stone fruits , adding a lively fruit sweetness that balances the barrel influence. As the coffee develops, the profile deepens into rich  whisky-like warmth , supported by pronounced  oakwood structure  and delicate  vanilla undertones  that linger into the finish. 
 This is a sophisticated coffee that highlights how  barrel aging can complement specialty coffee without overshadowing its natural fruit profile.  
 📍  Estate:  Udaygiri Estate, Chikmagalur 🌿  Process:  Natural Process with Whisky Barrel Aging 🪵  Barrel:  Seasoned Whisky Oak Barrels 🕒  Barrel Aging:  Controlled maturation in whisky barrels 🔥  Roast:  Light Plus 
 Tasting Notes 
 🥝 Kiwi 🍇 Grapes 🍑 Stone Fruits 🍏 Green Apple 🥃 Whisky 🪵 Oakwood 🍦 Vanilla 
 Flavor Intensity Guide 
 Oakwood – 3 / 4 Green Apple/ Stone Fruits – 2 / 4 Whisky – 3 / 4 Kiwi / Grapes   – 3 / 4 Vanilla – 2 / 4 
 Experience  Udaygiri Estate Oak Reserve —a distinctive barrel-aged microlot where bright fruit clarity meets the depth of whisky oak maturation.

description:
Vinum Obscura – Intenso Yeast Anaerobic Ferment  
  Nanolot Rarities | New Harvest  
  100% Arabica   
  Priced at ₹420 as an ode to Indian home brewers — for a limited 30-day launch window OR until green beans stock lasts, whichever comes first.   A small but deliberate contribution toward democratizing Indian specialty microlot coffees.  
 ☕  Roast Profile Available:   Light Plus  
 Vinum Obscura is our  most intense and layered expression yet —crafted for brewers who enjoy depth, structure, and wine-like complexity without sacrificing clarity. This nanolot is produced using a  controlled anaerobic fermentation with Intenso yeast , designed to amplify sweetness, dried-fruit richness, and refined fermentation character while remaining true to a Light Plus roast philosophy. 
 The cup opens with  luxurious raisin and dry-fruit sweetness , immediately setting a rich and rounded foundation. This is followed by  black grape and baked apple depth , adding juiciness and balance. As the brew cools, elegant  port-wine notes  emerge, supported by a smooth  dark-chocolate backbone  that brings length and composure to the finish. Acidity stays measured and polished, allowing body and sweetness to take center stage without harsh bitterness. 
 This is a composed, contemplative coffee—built to unfold slowly and reward attention rather than overwhelm. It reflects our belief that  Indian specialty coffee can be both sophisticated and accessible . 
  At ₹420 for the first 30 days(upto March 4th or lot sold out date), Vinum Obscura is intentionally priced as an ode to Indian home brewers.
